HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a relationship, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). MEDIUM CLOSE TWO-SHOT, waist-up, both faces large. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE TWO PEOPLE in the frame. TWO HUGE PERSONALITIES SIZING EACH OTHER UP. King Euija, bearded, in the Baekje king's black cap with twin gold flame ornaments, raises a wine cup with a broad grin; Yeon, massive, leans across the low table toward him with a loud laugh and a predator's eyes, his own cup held back. Two hard keys: amber on Euija, red on Yeon; a black seam between them. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = KING EUIJA; RIGHT of the sheet = YEON GESOMUN. KING EUIJA — Look: Broad, bearded king; black hair in a topknot with a yellow-gold headband whose tails trail; heavy brows, cynical eyes. Dress: Crimson robe with a dark charcoal collar and gold trim; a steel lamellar pauldron peeking at one shoulder. Crown: Baekje king: a tall rounded black silk cap (오라관) with a plain black band at the brow, and a pair of tall openwork gold flame-and-leaf ornaments (금제관식) pinned to either side of the cap, rising above it like twin flames — thin gold blades fanning upward with leaf buds and curls. On Euija the two side ornaments are King Muryeong's gold diadem ornaments exactly as the attached museum photo (ignore its backdrop): a pair of thin sheet-gold flame-and-honeysuckle sprays, each a central stem with curling leaf-flames fanning up and out, pierced openwork and hung with small round gold spangles, one pinned on each side of the black silk cap and rising well above it. Colour #e08a2e. | YEON GESOMUN — Look: Massive, broad-chested; black hair in a tight topknot tied with red cord; thick black beard trimmed close to the jaw, heavy brows, glaring eyes. Dress: Dark charcoal robe and trousers under red-edged armor, a red cape falling off the shoulders. Colour #d0362f. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a MINIMAL MONOTONE background — one flat dark field in a single hue (the characters' colour deepened almost to black), at most a few soft wisps of smoke in that same hue; no set, no architecture, no landscape, no furniture, no props beyond what the characters hold or sit on; ONE hard directional light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them — never a glow aura or halo. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show the relationship at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
